name: citypaj
description: Plataforma de voluntariado y servicios juveniles

scripts.dev:docker: docker-compose up -d postgres && npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.db:shell: docker exec -it citypaj-postgres psql -U postgres -d citypaj
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test

author: CityPaj Team
